_provenance: WI2 cell P (channel-death proof) decoy progression. Derived by hand from identity/chord_progression.json (canonical: C minor, G# major, A# major, C minor) by transposing every root +5 semitones (mod 12) while holding quality fixed, per Design Memo Section B. This guarantees (root, quality) differs from the canonical at every position: C(0)->F(5), G#(8)->C#(1 mod 12), A#(10)->D#(3 mod 12), C(0)->F(5).
